blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Arabic calligraphy is a high-stakes cultural visual domain for Muslim communities, yet VLM evaluations rarely test its fine-grained script traditions. We audit 12 VLMs on a cleaned 1,195-image six-way benchmark using numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first prompts. In this closed-set setting, the best numeric-prompt accuracy is 60.9% for closed/API models and 47.2% for open-weight models. The main failure is default-label collapse: every numeric run is dominated by a single label taking 33-63% of predictions, against an 18.8% majority-class baseline. For 8 of 12 models the default is Thuluth; GPT-4o labels 52.9% of all images as Thuluth although it is only 18.1% of the set. Prompting helps unevenly: visual cues move accuracy by more than 10 points for some models but hurt others, and foregrounding Diwani often relocates the default rather than removing it. Arabic calligraphy recognition is therefore a compact, culturally grounded stress test for VLM robustness and for measuring which visual traditions become legible to automated systems.
blocks.zh: 阿拉伯书法是穆斯林社区的一个高考文化视觉领域,然而VLM评价很少测试其精细的文字传统. 我们使用数字、视觉和Diwani的第一提示,对清理后的1,195-图像六向基准进行12个甚高频的审计。 在这种闭合设置中,收缩/API模型的收缩精度最好为60.9%,开口量模型为47.2%. 主要的失败是默认标签倒闭:每个数字运行都以一个单一的标签为主,使用33-63%的预测,而多数级基线为18.8%. 对于12个模型中的8个,默认为Thuluth;GPT-4o将所有图像的52.9%标为Thuluth,尽管它只占集的18.1%。 提示有不均匀的帮助:视觉提示为一些模型移动精度超过10分但伤害了其他模型,而预设的Diwani经常会迁移默认而非去除. 因此,阿拉伯文的书法识别是对VLM稳健性以及衡量哪些视觉传统可辨识到自动化系统的一种紧凑、基于文化的压力测试。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
This paper studies a narrow but important question: given an image of Arabic calligraphy, can modern vision–language models identify its script style rather than collapse it into a familiar label?
More specifically, when the choices are Kufic, Naskh, Thuluth, Diwani, Ruq’ah, and Nasta’liq, do models show stable visual discrimination, or do prompt wording and label order change which traditions become legible?
blocks.zh:
本文研究了一个狭义而重要的问题:鉴于阿拉伯书法的形象,现代视觉-语言模型能否识别出其脚本风格,而不是将其倒塌成一个熟悉的标签?
更具体地说,当选择库菲克、纳什克、图卢斯、迪瓦尼、鲁克和纳斯塔利克时,模型是否表现出稳定的视觉歧视,或者是否迅速改变措辞和标签顺序,哪些传统可以辨认?

blocks.en:
This question sits at the intersection of rapid VLM progress ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , culturally diverse vision evaluation ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Romero et al., 2024 ; Ramaswamy et al., 2023 ) , and evidence that model outputs can shift with option order and prompt format ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2022 ) .
Prior work introduced DuwatBench for Arabic calligraphy understanding ( Patle et al., 2026 ) ; we focus on whether VLMs have reliable style priors after rebalancing the evaluation set and testing controlled prompt interventions.
The task is culturally grounded for Muslim communities ( Muslims in ML, 2026 ) : calligraphic styles carry historical, religious, regional, and institutional associations, so systematic misclassification can distort access to visual heritage.
blocks.zh:
这个问题位于快速VLM进展的交汇点(Radford等,2021年;Alayrac等,2022年;Liu等,2023年;Liu等,2021年;Romero等,2024年;Ramaswamy等,2023年),有证据表明模型输出可以随选择顺序和即时格式而改变(郑等,2024年;Pezeshkpour和Hruschka,2024年;Sclar等,2024年;Lu等,2022年)。
先前的工作引入了Duwat Bench来理解阿拉伯语的书法(Patle等,2026年);我们专注于VLM在重新平衡评价组和测试可控即时干预后是否有可靠的风格前传.
这项任务对穆斯林社区(ML,2026年穆斯林)具有文化基础:书法风格承载着历史,宗教,区域,机构协会,因此系统性的分类错误会扭曲视觉遗产的获取.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • a cleaned and rebalanced 1,195-image benchmark for six-way Arabic calligraphy style recognition; • a controlled evaluation of four closed/API VLMs and eight open-weight VLMs on the same image manifest; • three prompt conditions—numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first—that test whether style descriptions or explicit attention to an under-recognized class repair errors; and • analyses of default-label collapse, Thuluth over-prediction, Diwani under-recognition, and paired prompt effects.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:对6道阿拉伯书法风格的识别进行清理和再平衡的1 195-图像基准;对4道封闭式/API VLM和8道开放式VLM进行对照评估;对3道快速条件——数字、视觉-cue和Diwani-First——进行测试,以检验样式描述或明确注意未得到充分承认的类修复错误;以及分析默认标签倒闭、Thuluth超预期、Diwani未识别以及配对的即时效应。

blocks.en: a cleaned and rebalanced 1,195-image benchmark for six-way Arabic calligraphy style recognition;
blocks.zh: 清理和再平衡1,195-图像基准,用于六行阿拉伯书法风格识别;

blocks.en: a controlled evaluation of four closed/API VLMs and eight open-weight VLMs on the same image manifest;
blocks.zh: 在同一图像显示表上对4个封闭/API VLM和8个开放式VLM进行控制评价;

blocks.en: three prompt conditions—numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first—that test whether style descriptions or explicit attention to an under-recognized class repair errors; and
blocks.zh: 三个即时条件——数字、视觉和Diwani第一——检验样式说明或明确注意未得到充分承认的类修复错误;

blocks.en: analyses of default-label collapse, Thuluth over-prediction, Diwani under-recognition, and paired prompt effects.
blocks.zh: 对默认标签崩溃、Thuluth过度预测、Diwani识别不足和配对的即时效应的分析。

blocks.en:
Our central finding is not simply that current VLMs are inaccurate.
Rather, their errors are culturally structured: many models overuse Thuluth as a default, fail to recover Diwani, and respond unevenly to prompts that should make the visual distinctions clearer.
blocks.zh:
我们的核心结论不单单是,目前的自愿终止措施是不准确的。
相反,它们的错误是文化结构的:许多模型过度使用Thuluth作为默认,无法恢复Diwani,并且对应当使视觉区别更清晰的提示做出不均匀的反应.

blocks.en: 2 Dataset and Task
blocks.zh: 2 数据集和任务

blocks.en:
We use a cleaned 1,195-image six-style dataset.
DuwatBench ( Patle et al., 2026 ) is supplemented with RuFa images for Ruq’ah/Nasta’liq ( Mhmoodlan, 2026 ) and HICMA images for Kufic/Naskh ( HICMA Project, 2026 ) , reducing the original Thuluth-heavy imbalance.
Curation uses source aggregation, single-label filtering, class-balance supplementation, file-integrity checks, duplicate removal, and manifest locking.
After removing one undersized image and four exact duplicates, the final counts are Kufic 106, Naskh 218, Thuluth 216, Diwani 217, Ruq’ah 225, and Nasta’liq 213; the majority baseline falls from 56.4% to 18.8%.
Thuluth and Diwani are both entirely DuwatBench, so their central confusion is not cross-source domain shift; other labels use mixed sources, disclosed in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个清理的1,195-图像六式数据集.
Duwat Bench(Patle等,2026年)由RuFa图像为Ruq'ah/Nasta'liq(Mhmoodlan,2026年)和HICMA图像为Kufic/Naskh(HICMA项目,2026年)所补充,减少了原先的Thuluth-havy不平衡.
校正使用源集合,单标签过滤,类平衡补充,文件集成检查,重复去除,并显示锁定.
在移除了一幅小图像和四个确切的重复后,最终的计数是:Kufic 106、Naskh 218、Thuluth 216、Diwani 217、Ruq'ah 225和Nasta ' liq 213;多数基线从56.4%下降到18.8%。
Thuluth和Diwani都是完全的Duwat Bench,所以他们的中心混淆不是跨源域转移;其他标签使用混合源,在附录中披露.

blocks.en:
The task is closed-set six-way style classification: given one image, select one script style.
We evaluate style recognition only, not OCR, transcription, semantic interpretation, religious-content judgment, or localization.
All metrics use the same 1,195-image manifest for every model–prompt run.
blocks.zh:
任务为闭合-集六道风格分类:给一个图像,选择一个脚本风格.
我们只评价风格识别,而不是OCR,抄写,语义解释,宗教内容判断,或本地化.
所有度量衡都使用相同的1,195-图像显示每个模型的即时运行。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use three prompts. Numeric lists numbered styles and requires one digit. Visual-cue adds short style descriptions. Diwani-first keeps the visual-cue framing but moves Diwani first and asks for the script name, testing whether foregrounding an under-recognized style rescues Diwani errors.
We introduced this condition after early runs showed Diwani was often missed or absorbed into Thuluth; it is a diagnostic prompt, not a preferred deployment prompt.
blocks.zh:
我们用三个提示。 数字列表编号样式并需要一位数字。 Visual-cue增加了短风格描述. Diwani-First保留了视觉-cue框架,但首先移动了Diwani并询问脚本名称,测试是否预设了未被识别的样式来拯救Diwani出错.
我们在早期运行显示迪瓦尼经常被错过或被吸收到Thuluth后,就引入了这个条件;这是一个诊断的即时,而不是首选的部署即时.

blocks.en:
We evaluate four closed/API models ( OpenAI, 2026 ) : GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.6 Terra.
The open-weight set includes Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL-8B/32B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , InternVL3.5-8B/38B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , MiniCPM-V 4.5 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma 4 12B-IT ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) .
Open-weight runs use greedy decoding with seed 42; closed/API runs use the most deterministic supported settings.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了四个封闭/API模型(OpenAI, 2026年):GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6 Terra。
开放重量包括: 文2.5-VL-7B/32B号 (Bai等人,2025年b),Quen3-VL-8B/32B(Bai等人,2025年a), InternVL3.5-8B/38B (Wang等,2025). MiniCPM-V 4.5 (Yu等,2025). Gemma 4 12B-IT (Gemma Team,2026).
开口量跑使用与种子42相配的贪婪解码;闭口量跑/API跑使用最决定性的支持设置.

blocks.en:
We report accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, per-style precision/recall/F1, and prediction ratio: predicted count divided by true count.
The main diagnostics are Thuluth prediction ratio and Diwani recall, because early runs absorbed ornate or uncertain examples into Thuluth while missing Diwani.
Paired prompt comparisons use exact McNemar tests on same-image correctness vectors; visual-cue changes with p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05 are marked not significant.
blocks.zh:
我们报告准确性,均衡准确性,宏-F1,每类精度/召回/F1,预测比:预测数除以真数.
主要诊断是Thuluth预测比和Diwani回想,因为早期在缺少Diwani的同时将被吸收的或不确定的例子流入Thuluth.
Paired即时比较使用精确的McNemar测试相同图像的正确性向量;可视-cue变化与p ± 0.05 p\geq 0.05没有显著标记.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the numeric-prompt comparison.
The best closed/API numeric-prompt accuracy is 60.9% (GPT-5.5), while the best open-weight numeric-prompt accuracy is 47.2% (Gemma 4 12B-IT).
Thus, although the task is visually compact and closed-set, it remains difficult for current VLMs.
blocks.zh:
表1汇总了数字-即时比较。
最佳闭塞/API数字快取精度为60.9%(GPT-5.5),而最佳开口量取精度为47.2%(Gemma 4 12B-IT).
因此,虽然这项任务是视觉上紧凑和封闭的,但对于目前的甚高压材料来说仍然是困难的。

blocks.en: Table 1: Numeric-prompt results. Thuluth bias is predicted/true Thuluth count; closer to 1.0 is better. Bold marks the best value within each model block.
blocks.zh: 表1:数字即时结果。 Thuluth 偏差是预测/ true Thuluth 计数; 接近 1.0 更好 。 粗体标出每个模型块内的最佳值.

blocks.en:
The dominant failure is default-label collapse, not random confusion.
Thuluth is over-predicted in 11 of 12 numeric-prompt runs; closed/API models choose it 2.05–2.93 × \times its true frequency, and Qwen3-VL-32B reaches 3.47 × \times .
This persists after rebalancing: every numeric run has one label taking at least one-third of predictions, rising to 52.9% for GPT-4o and 62.8% for Qwen3-VL-32B.
False Thuluth predictions most often come from true Diwani (40.9%), then Naskh (21.5%) and Nasta’liq (16.4%), suggesting both visual-neighbor confusion and an uncertainty default.
blocks.zh:
最主要的失败是默认-标签倒闭,而不是随机混淆.
Thuluth在12个数速跑的11个中被过度预测;闭合/API模型选择它2.05–2.93 ×\时间为它的真实频率,而Qune3-VL-32B达到3.47 ×\时间.
在再平衡后,这种情况继续存在:每个数字运行有一个至少占预测三分之一的标签,GPT-4o的升至52.9%,Qune3-VL-32B的升至62.8%。
假的Thuluth预测通常来自真实的Diwani(40.9%),然后是Naskh(21.5%)和Nasta'liq(16.4%),表明视觉-邻居混淆和不确定性默认。

blocks.en:
Diwani remains the clearest casualty.
GPT-4.1 recalls only 1.8% of Diwani images, while Qwen3-VL-32B and Gemma 4 12B-IT recall only 6.5%; InternVL3.5-38B reaches 56.2% recall but only 30.5% precision.
GPT-5.6 Terra is the only model with both non-trivial recall and stronger Diwani F1 (0.549).
Figure 1 visualizes this pair of errors: which true labels are absorbed into Thuluth and how much true Diwani each model recovers.
blocks.zh:
迪瓦尼仍然是最明显的伤亡者。
GPT-4.1只召回了1.8%的Diwani图像,而Qune3-VL-32B和Gemma 4 12B-IT只召回了6.5%;InternVL3.5-38B达到56.2%的召回,但精度只有30.5%.
GPT-5.6 Terra是唯一一种既具有非三角召回功能又具有更强大的Diwani F1(0.549.
图1可视化了这对错误:哪些真实的标签被吸收到Thuluth中,以及每个模型有多少真实的Diwani恢复.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Numeric-prompt failure structure. Left: stacked counts show which true labels are incorrectly absorbed into Thuluth. Right: Diwani recall remains low for many models despite higher overall accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图1:数字-瞬间故障结构. 左: 堆叠的计数显示哪些真实标签被错误地吸收到 Thuluth 中 。 右:Diwani召回率对许多型号来说仍然很低,尽管总体精度较高.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows that prompting does not behave like a uniform fix.
Visual cues improve some models, e.g., GPT-4o (+10.2 points) and Qwen2.5-VL-7B (+12.7), but hurt others, e.g., GPT-5.6 Terra (-7.3) and Gemma 4 12B-IT (-3.1); five of twelve changes are not significant.
Diwani-first can raise recall sharply, especially for InternVL3.5-8B (+89.9), but often relocates the default rather than repairing recognition: InternVL3.5-8B answers Diwani for 90.3% of all images, while Qwen3-VL models and Gemma 4 12B-IT still end with 0% Diwani recall.
blocks.zh:
图2显示,提示行为不像一个统一的固定。
视觉提示改进了一些模型,例如:GPT-4o(+10.2分)和Quen2.5-VL-7B(+12.7),但伤害了其他模型,例如:GPT-5.6 Terra (-7.3分)和Gemma 4 12B-IT (-3.1);十二个变化中的五个并不显著.
Diwani-first可以大幅提高召回,特别是对于InternVL3.5-8B(+89.9)来说,但通常会迁移默认而非修复识别: InternVL3.5-8B对所有图像的90.3%给出了Diwani的回答,而Quen3-VL模型和Gemma 4 12B-IT仍然以0%的Diwani回想结束.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Prompt effects relative to the numeric prompt. Visual cues are inconsistent; Diwani-first often raises Diwani recall at the cost of calibration.
blocks.zh: 图 2:相对于数字快取的快取效应. 视觉提示不一致;Diwani-first经常以校正为代价提高Diwani召回.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
This study supports a concrete claim: Arabic calligraphy recognition remains a brittle fine-grained cultural vision task for current VLMs.
Aggregate accuracy hides the main failure mode: models often behave like default-label emitters with partial discrimination layered on top.
Several models overuse Thuluth as the default label, while others collapse onto Naskh, Diwani, or Nasta’liq depending on model family and prompt.
These errors matter because calligraphic styles encode cultural, historical, and religious contexts, and automated tools should not collapse less-visible traditions into more familiar labels.
blocks.zh:
这项研究证实了一项具体主张: 阿拉伯书法的承认仍然是当前甚高压语言的粗略文化远景任务。
聚合精度隐藏了主要故障模式:模型的行为时常像默认标签发射器一样,上面有部分分层.
一些模型过度使用Thuluth作为默认标签,而其他模型则倒塌到Naskh、Diwani或Nasta'liq上,这取决于模型家族和迅速性。
这些错误很重要,因为书法风格将文化,历史和宗教背景编码,自动化工具不应将不太能见度的传统倒塌为更熟悉的标签.

blocks.en: The failure mode matters for education, museums, manuscript archives, social media, and community-facing search: collapsing Diwani, Ruq’ah, or Nasta’liq into Thuluth can distort access to Islamic visual heritage.
blocks.zh: 教育、博物馆、手稿档案、社交媒体以及社区化搜索的失败模式很重要:将Diwani、Ruq'ah或Nasta'liq倒入Thuluth会扭曲伊斯兰视觉遗产。

blocks.en: The study has limitations: it covers six broad labels rather than regional schools, mixed-style compositions, dating, handwriting, OCR, or localization; source and label are partly confounded for non-DuwatBench supplements; Prompt C confounds label order and response format; and API-served models can change over time.
blocks.zh: 该研究有局限性:它包括了6个宽标签而非区域学派,混合风格的成分,约会,笔迹,OCR,或本地化;来源和标签部分为非杜瓦特本奇补充品所困惑;Fource C混淆了标签顺序和响应格式;API服务型号可以随时间变化.

blocks.en:
Methodologically, the benchmark is useful because it separates two effects that are often blurred in cultural-vision evaluations.
The rebalanced manifest reduces the chance that high Thuluth prediction is simply learned from label frequency, while the prompt interventions show whether the same images become more legible when models are given style descriptions or an explicit Diwani prior.
The negative result is therefore informative: even when a prompt names the right visual features, many systems still substitute a familiar-looking script for the correct one.
blocks.zh:
从方法上讲,这一基准是有用的,因为它将文化-视觉评价中往往模糊的两种影响分开来。
重新平衡的表征降低了高Thuluth预测仅仅从标签频率中学习的机会,而即时干预则显示当模型被给予样式描述时,同样的图像是否变得更加清晰可辨,或者一个明显的Diwani前作.
因此负面的结果是翔实的:即使一个即时点出正确的视觉特征,许多系统仍然用一个熟悉的脚本来代替正确的脚本.

blocks.en: For deployment, prompt descriptions are not enough: systems that classify or retrieve Arabic calligraphy should report uncertainty, validate performance per style, and avoid treating high aggregate accuracy as evidence that all traditions are equally legible.
blocks.zh: 对于部署来说,即时描述是不够的:分类或检索阿拉伯语书法的系统应当报告不确定性,验证每个样式的性能,并避免将高总精度作为所有传统都同样可以辨认的证据.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present a 12-model evaluation of Arabic calligraphy style recognition under three prompt conditions.
The results reveal limited accuracy, recurring Thuluth over-prediction, Diwani under-recognition, and nonuniform prompt sensitivity across closed/API and open-weight VLMs.
Arabic calligraphy therefore offers a compact culturally grounded benchmark for measuring not only model accuracy, but how errors redistribute visibility across significant visual traditions.
blocks.zh:
我们提出在三个迅速条件下对阿拉伯书法风格的识别进行12种模式评价。
结果显示准确性有限,反复出现Thuluth过度预测,Diwani识别不足,以及封闭式/API和开放式VLM的不统一即时敏感.
因此,阿拉伯书法提供了一个基于文化的紧凑基准,不仅用于衡量模型的准确性,而且用于衡量错误如何在重要的视觉传统中重新分配能见度。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset construction details
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建细节

blocks.en:
The evaluated dataset contains 1,195 single-label Arabic calligraphy images.
It was constructed from DuwatBench ( Patle et al., 2026 ) plus real-image supplements from RuFa ( Mhmoodlan, 2026 ) and HICMA ( HICMA Project, 2026 ) used to reduce the original class imbalance.
Curation followed a fixed pipeline: aggregate source images, retain single-label six-style items, supplement underrepresented classes, check image-file integrity, remove exact duplicates and undersized files, then lock the manifest used for all inference runs.
The final manifest contains 106 Kufic, 218 Naskh, 216 Thuluth, 217 Diwani, 225 Ruq’ah, and 213 Nasta’liq images.
Table 2 reports the source composition by label.
Thuluth and Diwani share the same DuwatBench provenance, so their central confusion in the main results is not a cross-source artifact; other labels should be interpreted with the mixed-source composition in mind.
Before model evaluation, the dataset was checked for missing files, corrupted images, orphan images, undersized images, and exact duplicates.
One undersized image and four duplicate images were removed.
Figure 3 shows representative examples from the final six-style evaluation set.
blocks.zh:
被评价的数据集包含有1,195个单标签的阿拉伯书法图像.
它由Duwat Bench(Patle等,2026年)加上RuFa(Mhmoodlan,2026年)和HICMA(HICMA Project,2026年)的真相补充而来建造,用于减少原有的阶级不平衡.
校正遵循了固定的管道:集合源图像,保留单标签六式项目,补充代表性不足的类别,检查图像文件完整性,去掉精确的重复和缩放文件,然后锁定用于所有推论运行的表单.
最终清单包含106个Kufic、218个Naskh、216个Thuluth、217个Diwani、225个Ruq'ah和213个Nasta'liq图像。
表2按标签报告来源构成。
Thuluth和Diwani共享相同的Duwat Bench出处,因此他们在主要结果中的中心混淆不是一出相通的文物;其他标签应该从混合相通的成分来解释.
在模型评价前,对所缺文件,被损坏的图像,孤儿的图像,被低估的图像,以及准确的重复进行数据集检查.
一个尺寸不足的图像和四个重复的图像被取出.
图3显示最后六类评价中的代表性例子。

blocks.en: Appendix B Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: The prompt text below is line-wrapped for page layout.
blocks.zh: 下面的即时文本被行包为页面布局.

blocks.en: You are shown an Arabic calligraphy image. Below are six possible styles, each with a number: 1. Kufic 2. Naskh 3. Thuluth 4. Diwani 5. Ruq’ah 6. Nasta’liq Respond with only the number of the style that best matches this image. Respond with a single digit only -- no words, no explanation.
blocks.zh: 您将被显示阿拉伯书法图像 。 下面是六个可能的样式,每个样式都有数字: 1. 库菲克 2. 纳什克 3. 锡卢斯 4. 迪瓦尼语 5. 鲁卡 6. 纳斯塔利克 仅以最适合此图像的样式数响应 。 仅用一位数字回复——无词,无解释.

blocks.en: You are shown an Arabic calligraphy image. Classify its calligraphic style. Choose exactly one of these six styles: 1. Kufic 2. Naskh 3. Thuluth 4. Diwani 5. Ruq’ah 6. Nasta’liq Use the following visual cues: - Kufic: angular, geometric, squared or block-like letterforms; strong horizontal/vertical structure; often rigid and monumental. - Naskh: clear, balanced, readable manuscript style; rounded letters; moderate stroke contrast; commonly used for Qur’anic and book text. - Thuluth: large, elegant, sweeping curves; elongated verticals; complex decorative composition; often used in architectural or ceremonial calligraphy. - Diwani: highly cursive and ornamental; dense flowing curves; letters may interlace; often compact and decorative. - Ruq’ah: simple, fast handwriting-like style; compact letters; short strokes; practical and less ornamental. - Nasta’liq: diagonal/slanted baseline; hanging or cascading composition; soft flowing curves; common in Persian/Urdu calligraphy. Base your answer only on visible visual style, not on the meaning of the text, image background, decoration, or color. If multiple styles seem possible, choose the closest match based on the dominant letter shapes and composition. Respond with only a single digit from 1 to 6. Do not explain.
blocks.zh: 您将被显示阿拉伯书法图像 。 将其书法风格分类. 选择这六种风格中的一种: 1. 库菲克 2. 纳什克 3. 锡卢斯 4. 迪瓦尼语 5. 鲁卡 6. 纳斯塔利克 使用下列可视提示: - Kufic:角形,几何形,平方形或块状的字母形式;强水平/垂直结构;常为刚性并具有纪念性. - Naskh:清晰,平衡,可读的手稿风格;圆形字母;中风对比;常用"古兰经"和"书"文字. - Thuluth:大而优雅,宽阔的曲线;纵长;装饰成分复杂;常被用在建筑或礼仪书法上. - 迪瓦尼:有很强的咒语和装饰;有密集的流出曲线;字母可能交错;往往有紧凑和装饰. - Ruqah:简单而快的笔迹风格;紧凑的字母;短打;实用而不太有装饰性。 - Nasta-liq:对角/斜线基线;悬挂或串联组成;软流曲线;常见于波斯语/乌尔都语书法. 答案只以可见的视觉风格为基础,而不是以文字、图像背景、装饰或颜色的含义为基础。 如果多个样式看起来是可能的,则根据主字母形状和组成选择最接近的匹配. 以从1到6只有一位数字的响应. 别解释

blocks.en: Look carefully at the calligraphic strokes, curves, and letterforms in this Arabic calligraphy image. Based on the following characteristics, determine which classical script family it belongs to: Diwani: highly cursive and ornamental; dense flowing curves; letters may interlace; often compact and decorative. Kufic: angular, geometric, squared or block-like letterforms; strong horizontal/vertical structure; often rigid and monumental. Naskh: clear, balanced, readable manuscript style; rounded letters; moderate stroke contrast; commonly used for Qur’anic and book text. Thuluth: large, elegant, sweeping curves; elongated verticals; complex decorative composition; often used in architectural or ceremonial calligraphy. Ruq’ah: simple, fast handwriting-like style; compact letters; short strokes; practical and less ornamental. Nasta’liq: diagonal/slanted baseline; hanging or cascading composition; soft flowing curves; common in Persian/Urdu calligraphy. Base your answer only on visible visual style, not on the meaning of the text, image background, decoration, or color. State only the name of the script."
blocks.zh: 仔细地看一看这个阿拉伯书法图象中的书法笔划,曲线和字母形式. 基于以下特征,确定它属于哪个古典剧本家族: 第瓦尼:高度曲折和装饰;密集的流出曲线;字母可能间接;常为紧凑和装饰. 克菲克:角形,几何形,平方形或块状的字母形;强水平/垂直结构;常为刚性而有立体. 纳斯克:清晰,平衡,可读的手稿风格;圆形字母;中度中风对比;常用"古兰经"和"书"文字. Thuluth:大,优雅,宽阔的曲线;纵长;装饰成分复杂;常被用在建筑或礼仪书法上. Ruqah: 简单而快的笔迹风格; 紧凑的字母; 短打; 实用而较少的装饰. Nasta'liq:对角/斜基线;悬挂或相接组成;软流曲线;常见于波斯语/乌尔都语书法. 答案只以可见的视觉风格为基础,而不是以文字、图像背景、装饰或颜色的含义为基础。 只写剧本的名字"

blocks.en: Appendix F Reproducibility notes
blocks.zh: 附录F 复制说明

blocks.en:
All model–prompt runs use the same 1,195-row manifest.
Open-weight experiments use fixed seed 42 and greedy decoding.
Closed/API experiments were run with deterministic settings where supported; GPT-5-family models did not support the same temperature setting as GPT-4-family models, which limits exact reproducibility.
All closed/API CSVs and open-weight JSONL outputs are retained locally together with the script that regenerates summary metrics.
blocks.zh:
所有型号–即时运行使用相同的1,195行显示.
开放量子实验使用固定种子42并贪取解码.
封闭式/API实验在有支持的确定性环境中进行;GPT-5-家庭模型不支持与GPT-4-家庭模型相同的温度设定,这限制了准确的再生产性。
所有已关闭/API的CSV和开放量的JSONL输出都保留在当地,同时保留重新生成汇总度量的脚本.

blocks.en: Appendix G Original DuwatBench-only context
blocks.zh: 附录G Duwat Bench 只设置上下文

blocks.en:
Before constructing the cleaned/rebalanced 1,195-image evaluation set, exploratory runs were conducted on the original DuwatBench ( Patle et al., 2026 ) -style 1,272-row files.
Those files include 20 multi-label or ambiguous true-label rows; Table 4 reports metrics after excluding them.
We do not mix these numbers into the main comparison because they use a different dataset distribution and fewer models.
They are nevertheless useful context: original DuwatBench is strongly Thuluth-heavy, so raw accuracy can look high even when balanced accuracy remains modest.
blocks.zh:
在建造被清理/再平衡的1,195个图像评价套件之前,在最初的Duwat Bench(Patle等,2026年)----1,272行的文件上进行了探索性运行。
这些文件包括20个多标签或模棱两可的真标签行; 表4在排除后报告衡量标准。
我们并不将这些数字混入主比较中,因为它们使用不同的数据集分布和较少的模型.
尽管如此,它们还是有用的上下文:原始的杜瓦特奔驰(Duwat Bench)具有很强的Thuluth-havy,因此,即使平衡的准确度仍然不高,原始的精度也可以看起来很高.

blocks.en: Table 4: Original DuwatBench-only context runs on the clean six-class subset. These are not part of the main 36-run comparison. Bold marks the best value in each metric column.
blocks.zh: 表4: 原始 Duwat Bench 上下文运行在干净的六等子集上. 这些不是36次主要比较的一部分。 粗体标出每个公分栏中的最佳值。

blocks.en:
These context runs support two design choices in the main paper.
First, they motivate rebalancing: the original clean six-class subset has a 56.4% majority-class baseline because Thuluth dominates the dataset.
Second, they show why prompt effects should be interpreted cautiously: GPT-4o’s alternative wording run greatly increases Diwani recall while reducing overall accuracy, suggesting that prompt changes can swap the default label rather than solve fine-grained recognition.
blocks.zh:
这些上下文支持主要文件中的两个设计选择。
首先,它们促使重新平衡:最初的清洁六等子集有56.4%的多数级基线,因为Thuluth主导了数据集.
其次,它们表明为什么应该谨慎地解释即时效应:GPT-4o的替代措辞大大提高了Diwani的回忆,同时降低了总体准确性,表明即时更改可以互换默认标签,而不是解决细微的识别问题。
